shared_qualifications: C1: source alloy formulas are atomic percentages, whereas CRA element columns are wt%. For a complete ternary formula, wt%_i = 100*x_i*M_i / sum(x_j*M_j). Atomic weights from CIAAW Abridged Standard Atomic Weights 2024 (https://ciaaw.org/abridged-atomic-weights.htm): Al26.982, Co58.933, Ce140.12, Ni58.693, Y88.906, Fe55.845, Gd157.25. Only relevant elements enter each explicitly stated ternary; no omitted alloy component is filled from CRA.

C2: V(SCE)*1000=mV(SCE); scale +/- by1000 and then form endpoints. Table II uncertainty is reported at99% confidence, not observed population extremes. The nanocrystalline source value is positive+0.044 V and is preserved as printed.

Microelectrode area is10^-4 cm2; the separate footnote result is for10^-1 cm2 pure-Al electrodes. The larger-area result is not substituted for the microelectrode mean. BracketedAl-Ni-Y entries occur only in the repassivation row, so no extra Epit observation is inferred.

Ep uses an anodic-current criterion two orders above passive current (PDF p.2), not an inferred reversal endpoint. Tests use N2-purged0.6 M NaCl,pH5.9,25 C,one-hourOCP and0.1 mV/s scan. Source heat treatments are150 C/25 h and550 C/1 h (PDF pp.1-2); CRA water-quench text is retained as metadata not independently established in these passages.
Poppler returned success but warned of missing Symbol/ArialNarrow display fonts. The registered Table II, footnote, methods and captions were visually legible; no anchor was blocked.
